description: SGLang's own refusals the port quotes (oracle/refusal_quotes.json), each executed through SGLang's own code at the pinned commit by oracle/run_refusals.py. A case of kind `policy` calls SchedulePolicy._validate_and_adjust_policy (managers/schedule_policy.py:318-344); `tree_cache` calls mem_cache/registry.py create_tree_cache with a tree cache of the named class, registered through SGLang's own register_radix_cache_backend; `server_args` runs ServerArgs(...).resolve_once() then .check_server_args() (server_args.py:508, called at entrypoints/engine.py:1165). `engine_args` is the ServerArgs block the port is given for the same input; `engine_refuses` says whether the port must raise the refusal (false: SGLang accepts the input, so the port must not raise SGLang's message, SIM-9).
